==Description==
This [[Wookieepedia:Userboxes|userbox]] can be added to the userpage of anyone who has earned the honor of becoming a [[Wookieepedia:Wookieepedian of the Month|Wookieepedian of the Month]].

==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>UserWotM|{{Var|month}}|{{Var|year}}}}</code> into your user page.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|month}}}} The month when the award was bestowed.
#{{Para||{{Var|year}}}} The year when the award was bestowed.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="3">{{Para|multiple}} Set to <code>1</code> if the user has received the award more than once, and left blank otherwise.</li>

==Categorization==
*[[:Category:Wookieepedians of the Month]]
*[[:Category:Wookieepedians of the Month (multiple winners)]] {{C|for {{Para|multiple|1}}}}

==Examples==
{| class="wikitable"
! Code !! Result
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{UserWotM|July|2006}}</nowiki></code> || {{UserWotM|July|2006}}
|}

[[Category:Wiki userboxes|WoTM]]</noinclude>
